text:
jen: Noticed an alert. Console quotas look off for last hour, lots of traffic in "unknown route". Suspect this ties to the compact header pilot.
liam: Confirmed on staging. The router parser expects long-form header `X-Route-Tags`. Canary SDKs are sending `X-RT` compact encoding. Our ingestion drops unrecognized headers.
priya: Which SDKs rolled the compact header? Py + TS rolled the compact shim last Wednesday; Go hasn't.
ev an: Go remains on the legacy header until we cut the next patch.
samir: Example payload we saw: `X-RT: r=serviceA|env=canary|team=payments` 00ms requests are not attributed. Parser currently splits on commas and expects JSON-ish value.
jen: That explains quota mis-attribution. Customers who rely on per-route quotas see spikes in the unknown bucket.
priya: Quick remediation proposal: update route-parser to accept either header name (`X-Route-Tags` or `X-RT`) and normalize both to canonical route_meta before metric aggregation. I'll draft a small tolerant parser.
liam: Also propose SDK safety flag `EMIT_CANONICAL_ROUTE` default=false. Releases set the flag per-tenant, then flip after 2 weeks. Avoid surprise changes.
ev an: For Go we should expose the flag via env var and keep runtime opt-in. Static linking constraints mean releasing a major bump is painful.
jen: Console UX: add an inline banner when unknown attribution >5% with short steps: 1) check SDK version 2) enable canonical header flag 3) link to migration doc.
console-team: We can add banner. Need short copy and a doc URL.
ops-bot: started rollout: route-parser v1.2 -> staging
priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1299 - adds X-RT parsing, unit tests, and a normalization layer. Sample parser snippet in tests: `def parse_xrt(hdr): parts = hdr.split('|'); kv = {}; for p in parts[1:]: if '=' in p: k,v = p.split('=',1); kv[k]=v; return kv`
samir: After staging deploy and smoke, unknown bucket dropped from ~22% to ~2.3% :thumbsup:
liam: Roll to prod in 30m. Then release patch to Py/TS clients with the feature flag and docs.
jen: File a docs task to update telemetry contract and metrics mapping table in Confluence before we flip defaults. Also add monitoring alert: unknown-route >2% for 5m -> page.
ops-bot: alert created: unknown-route-rate >2% (5m) -> #incidents
priya: After prod roll, follow up with a short retrospective and include guidance for third-party integrators.
liam: Agree. Also add a migration checklist for customer-facing SDK changes so we don't surprise anyone next time.
jen: Thanks everyone. Ill post the timeline in #eng-announce and link the PR + docs.
